snippet.title: 10-Month-Old Baby JOINS my violin street performance
snippet.description:
While I was playing “I Want to Know What Love Is” by Foreigner on my violin, the sweetest little surprise happened! 🎻❤️

An adorable 10-month-old baby came over to listen to the music, watched me with so much curiosity, and even started dancing! 🥹❤️ It was such a precious moment, and I’m so happy I got to share it with you.

I love how music can bring joy to people of all ages, even the tiniest listeners! 🎶

What did you think of this sweet little music lover? Let me know in the comments! 😊

Thank you so much for watching and supporting my music!

You can support me by streaming or getting my music here! 👇

- iTunes: https://music.apple.com/us/album/sky/1484467531
- Amazon: https://www.amazon.com/Sky-Karolina-Protsenko/dp/B07ZFTM5QD/ref=sr_1_1?keywords=karolina+protsenko+sky&qid=1571937980&sr=8-1
- Spotify: https://open.spotify.com/track/1BHJmOYESxQ41FcQpHnZIP?si=DkrvStaBSTeOS94rgGl2eA

snippet.title: Grand Theft Auto VI Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Vice City, USA. Jason and Lucia have always known the deck is stacked against them. But when an easy score goes wrong, they find themselves on the darkest side of the sunniest place in America, in the middle of a criminal conspiracy stretching across the state of Leonida — forced to rely on each other more than ever if they want to make it out alive.

Check out the new Launch Trailer, featuring new music from electronic duo Justice, composers of the original score from Grand Theft Auto VI. 

The new standalone Justice single, “Flower in a Hurricane” feat. Tame Impala, SZA, and King Gizzard & The Lizard Wizard, is also available on Grand Theft Auto VI: The Album, the official soundtrack which is currently available to pre-save on all major music streaming services and up for pre-order on vinyl or CD.

Grand Theft Auto VI arrives November 19.

snippet.title: [NP] 2026 PMGO S2 Main Event | Grand Finals Day 2 | PUBG MOBILE GLOBAL OPEN Season 2
snippet.description:
Final Day. Match Point Threshold lock bhai sakyo, Showmatch le M13 map ban kasle control garchha bhanera decide garnechha, ra 16 teams ra 2026 PMGO S2 title ko bichma 13 matches samma baki chhan. Jalle trophy lift garcha, usle pratyek point dherai mehnat le kamayeko hunechha.

Ra SMASH RULE play ma chha, trophy claim garne sabai bhanda exciting tarika. Threshold hit garnuhos ra euta match win sangai match close out garnuhos, ani title tapaikos hunchha.

🏆 2026 PUBG MOBILE GLOBAL OPEN Season 2 | Grand Finals Day 2

📋 FORMAT

🔥 SMASH RULE
SMASH Rule trophy claim garne sabai bhanda exciting tarika ho. Yo season ma yasle kasari kaam garchha, yaha chha:
Day 1 ko Overall Ranking #1 team ko points + 10point = Match Point Threshold
Day 2 ma yo Threshold hit garnuhos, tyas pachi title claim garnako lagi arko euta match win garnuhos.

No SMASH? Standard Overall Ranking under ma sabai bhanda highest total points le win garchha.   

🆕 NEW THIS SEASON: Showmatch + M13   
Day 2 ko start M7 bhanda agadi euta Themed-Map Showmatch bata hunchha.  Yadi M12 ko end samma pani kunei team le title clinch gareko chhainabhane, euta M13 add hunchha, jun no matter what final match hunechha.
M13 map 2 steps ma decide hunchha: Showmatch winner le 3 maps (Rondo, Erangel, Miramar) madhye 1 ban garchha, tyas pachi M12 ko points leader le remaining 2 maps madhye euta map select garchha.
